sources.title: bmars8218/zils-lite-body-2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: zils-lite-body-2 A soup-pool body (language and vision weights) for the d3-lite pool of Zils (Bittensor subnet 127). It is evaluated on the pool's pinned chassis; the chassis supplies the answer layer, prompt and runtime.

sources.snippet: The Next.js website for Zils decision models, public research, the inference playground, and the experimental customer training dashboard. The intended production domain is https://zils.ai. The model and subnet implementation lives in ooo-hq/zils. The Fez chat application remains a separate project ...
